item.title: A Search-and-Inference Database from Scratch in Pure Zig | Antfly
Persistent Databases in the Browser with DuckDB-Wasm and OPFS
item.description: DuckDB-Wasm can open a persistent database file in the browser's Origin Private File System (OPFS). This post shows how, and when data reaches disk. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Alibaba Open Sources OpenCodeReview for AI-Assisted Code Review
item.description: Alibaba recently open-sourced OpenCodeReview, an AI-powered code review CLI that combines deterministic pipelines for file selection, bundling, and rule matching with an LLM agent for dynamic code analysis. (1 source: infoq)
